title: NAQD Env: A benchmark for selective withdrawal in language agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.38460v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language agents must revise planned actions when evidence changes, permission is revoked, or a stop instruction arrives. A useful response is selective: suspend affected actions, preserve unaffected work, and resume only after sufficient repair. We introduce NAQD-Env, a synthetic environment that evaluates these decisions against a deterministic reference policy over explicit evidence, authorization, and constraint dependencies. Eleven dependency families support evaluation on development structures, held-out families, and held-out combinations of structures. Metrics distinguish attempted violations from violations permitted by a simulated execution gate and jointly report policy agreement, task value, withdrawal, resumption, and event reporting. We evaluate three open-weight instruction-tuned models from two families under three prompt conditions on 350 frozen scenarios, yielding 3,150 model-prompt episodes before gate replay. Across th

translated_title: NAQD Env：面向语言智能体选择性撤回的基准测试
translated_abstract: 摘要：当证据发生变化、权限被撤销或收到停止指令时，语言智能体必须修订已规划的动作。一种有用的响应是选择性的：暂停受影响的动作，保留未受影响的工作，并仅在充分修复后才恢复执行。我们介绍了NAQD-Env，这是一个合成环境，它基于明确的证据、授权和约束依赖关系，对照确定性参考策略来评估这些决策。十一个依赖关系族支持在开发结构、留出依赖族以及留出的结构组合上进行评估。相关指标能够区分尝试性违规与被模拟执行门控所允许的违规，并联合报告策略一致性、任务价值、撤回、恢复和事件上报情况。我们在350个冻结场景下，于三种提示条件下评估了来自两个模型家族的三个开源权重指令微调模型，在门控重放之前共产生了3,150个模型-提示回合。在（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了NAQD-Env，一个用于评估语言智能体在证据变化、权限撤销或停止指令下进行选择性动作撤回能力的合成基准环境，其包含十一个依赖关系族，并能区分尝试性违规与被执行门控允许的违规。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces NAQD-Env, a synthetic benchmark environment for evaluating selective withdrawal decisions in language agents against a deterministic reference policy, featuring eleven dependency families and metrics that distinguish attempted violations from gate-permitted violations.
